desc:
A whole life, from birth to the end. Every choice comes back.
You don’t choose where you’re born. In 8 BILLION, you’re born at random somewhere on Earth, based on real world births: a country, a city, a family. Grow up, study, work, love, start a family, and make decisions that come back years later, until the end of your life. Then start again somewhere else. Or live it together: invite a friend, be born the same year in the same city and make decisions together.

• 80 countries and hundreds of cities
• Thousands of situations and choices
• Duo mode: a whole life with a friend
• Loved ones who remember what you did
• A summary of every life, kept in your archives

And you, where will you be born?
